args.message:
Upgrade fastjson to 2.9.4 to fix CVE-2026-31337

fastjson 2.8.0 is affected by CVE-2026-31337 (high severity:
unbounded recursion when parsing deeply nested arrays), fixed in
2.9.4. Pin fastjson to 2.9.4.

args.body:
fastjson 2.8.0 is affected by CVE-2026-31337 (high severity): unbounded recursion when parsing deeply nested arrays. Affected: <2.9.4. This PR pins fastjson to 2.9.4, the fix version.

- Updated requirements.txt: fastjson==2.8.0 -> fastjson==2.9.4
- CI run ci-0001 on commit c8b8ab7878: passed
